keys.manual_admin.tools.botrunner.title: Bot Runner
keys.manual_admin.tools.botrunner.desc: Development tool to simulate players and test the server under real load.
keys.manual_admin.tools.botrunner.usage_desc: Open the lobby from the presenter first. Enter the Session ID (PIN-NUMBER format), choose mode (individual or teams), game type (quiz or trivial) and the number of bots (1-199), then press "Launch bots".
keys.manual_admin.tools.botrunner.stats_desc: Shows connected bots, failed bots and submitted answers in real time. You can stop the bots at any moment and download a JSON log of the run.
